title: Room-in-room winter heat refuge
summary: Reduces occupied space during cold outages without unsafe indoor combustion.
content: Room-in-room winter heat refuge is a practical offline routine for cold shelter. Choose the smallest safe room away from broken windows, damp walls, and carbon monoxide risks. Block drafts with fabric while keeping required ventilation; never use charcoal, grills, or generators indoors. Create a sleeping zone away from cold floors using rugs, cardboard, or raised bedding. Group people by warmth needs while protecting privacy, illness separation, and mobility access. Check condensation, damp bedding, cold injuries, and candle/fire hazards every shift.
